scope: These are my proposed complete future tasks and prior judging rules, not tested audio or measured assistant answers. Noise level/recording setup would need to be fixed and recorded before collecting results; three examples would support only that small set.
after_configuration_changes: A changed adapter/base/recognizer or compression changes the delivered package, so identify and check the new configuration and files, check that the needed route still runs, and reevaluate complete tasks in the affected capability groups. If the recognizer changes, compare source transcription and both answer routes separately; if data or training settings change, use validation to select the new candidate and keep a new final test for its reported capability.
